cloud_check_authority.limit: A cloud smoke must never inherit the local trusted_check claim. Local SQLite missions run their checks under the coordinator's own trusted check runner.
cloud_check_authority.post_hackathon: Deterministic server-side check execution and server-minted receipts.
cloud_check_authority.truth: For the cloud dispatch path an authenticated remote executor is part of the trusted computing base. The coordinator recomputes the receipt's bindings — mission/task/attempt/plan/fence/policy identity, the exact publication envelopes, and the receipt-to-evidence digest — and does NOT recompute template_sha256, candidate_tree_sha256, output_sha256, exit_code, timed_out or cleanup_complete, nor re-run any check. A hand-built passing receipt with arbitrary digests is accepted at this boundary by design. Every successful cloud completion records check_authority: executor_attested in the committed task.completed payload, inside payload_sha256 and the event_sha256 chain.

cloud_unsupported_transitions.abandon: Disabled for this release. The route returns 501 ABANDON_UNSUPPORTED and never reaches the store, and connect_executor no longer calls it: abandon_dispatch wrote the lease slot, outbox and session but emitted no event, did not advance the head, and left the attempt and task RUNNING with the lease still counting against max_concurrency. A shutdown after a claim now leaves the lease to expire on TTL.
cloud_unsupported_transitions.multi_executor: Refused at registration with MultiExecutorUnsupported -> 409 MULTI_EXECUTOR_UNSUPPORTED. One mission-wide expected head means a second executor's claim would conflict at a random later moment; it now fails closed immediately with a named reason. Same-id reconnect still works and a session idle past the lease bound stops blocking. Cloud parallelism is NOT claimed anywhere.
cloud_unsupported_transitions.post_hackathon: The transactional-head redesign: the server reads the current head transactionally for executor operations, the client head becomes observation rather than mutation authority, and two interleaved sessions are tested against the emulator.

failure_aware_retry.truth: A failed trusted check leaves a redacted CheckDiagnostic bound to the attempt; the retry's worker payload carries the prior attempt id, its fence, the result code, the failed check names, the receipt digest and the summary, with an unchanged repair scope. A repeat of the same failure signature is terminal. Observed live in both directions on 2026-08-23: 3/3 injected faults repaired on the retry, and mission_start_b6be7f35ba803c6dc34597b1 terminalized on a repeated signature instead of taking a third attempt.

final_bundle_authority.limit: The recompute rebuilds trees, patches and mutation manifests from the repository. It still trusts the TrustedCheckReceipt's claim that the checks passed; it does not re-run tests.
final_bundle_authority.truth: register_final_result_bundle fails closed unless a repository-aware recompute is bound, runs it, and issues a FinalBundleVerificationReceiptV1 into the FINAL_RESULT_BUNDLE_READY event. Approval, rejection and cold verification all refuse a bundle that does not carry a server receipt binding it exactly. The adversarial test that used to document the hole now enforces the fix.

graph_economics.truth: The equal-quality-gate, three-mode, non-overwriting harness has a credential-free unit test. No real repeated run, token/cost/latency result, median, or P95 is claimed.

legs.survives_one_of_them_failing: verified_live — 3/3 controlled-failure missions completed after recovery on 2026-08-23. Each was started with `graphene mission start --inject-check-fault`, which fails the first trusted check exactly once (exit 97, receipt labelled simulated_fixture / demo_injected_deterministic_check_failure). In every one the failed attempt sat at fence 1, the retry ran at fence 2 carrying the redacted diagnostic, the retry was committed, the sibling work task was untouched, and the mission reached awaiting_result. planning_source_binding.truth: Planning reads the manifest from `git ls-tree -r -l -z --full-tree <base_sha>` and excerpt bytes from `git cat-file blob`, so the planner sees exactly the commit the workers clone and detach to. Tracked or staged drift from that commit is rejected by name before any byte is selected. No path under the repository is opened during planning, which removes the intermediate-directory-symlink escape by construction rather than by a stronger open().

product_thesis: Graphene is a local-first mission control for bounded multi-agent coding work. Give it one engineering outcome; it validates a dependency-aware work graph, dispatches only policy-allowed isolated work, adapts to bounded failures, assembles accepted artifacts, verifies the result, and creates an isolated local commit only after explicit approval.
result: An exact verified candidate decision and optional isolated local commit with V2 publication evidence, a registered immutable pre-decision bundle, explicit resource semantics, and unresolved unknowns. Bounded ADK workers, collision-safe tree hashing, cold integrity verification, revision/invalidation, and a partial authoritative Firestore/outbound-executor vertical are credential-free tested; external proof remains separate.
